speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Give me the purse. I will count what should come home, and I will not make a sermon of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Count it. The purse is not the coffer.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: A shilling. A shilling. A shilling. And a shilling. These four come home. The road may eat the rest, and I am not naming the rest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four shillings home. I have them.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thy shirt. I have turned the collar. Wear it when thou comest in, and do not cut it on the road.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I am not asking thee the question. I asked it. Thou gave me three. I said I would leave it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not a fourth answer in the purse.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then do not invent one at the gate. The rag is tied. The collar is turned. That is the whole of what I am handing thee.
